hypothesis: At equal parameters and realized training exposure, the untied shared learner predicts fixed post-acquisition withheld-composition queries more accurately than a flat GRU.

design.self_contact: Separate first held-out self-contact; one physical query, no reversed duplicate
design.acquisition: First existing distinct contact; precontact 01/10/11 selected before mode; full feedback through acquisition
design.queries: Every later contact position fixed before mode/outcomes; single-contact has zero continuation queries
design.observations: Full train/selection/calibration; evaluation has 0..3 exogenous missing bit-events after acquisition; self full
design.deduplication: Canonical blueprint/reversal/renaming, before hidden mode; no cross-split blueprint or lineage overlap
design.query_criterion_scope: New prospective post-acquisition scope; original protocols/95 target and archived failures unchanged

paired_initialization: shared and reset receive identical initial tensors for each model seed; flat uses same seed label, different architecture

fit.cpu_limit_outcome: STOP_INCOMPLETE_EXPOSURE; retain actual costs/partial outputs; no retry

diagnostics: acquisition excess over ln2 NLL and 0.5 Brier floors

analysis.primary_metric: OOD continuation exactness: equal families, then eligible(N,contact_count)cells, then physical draws; within draw mean over both views and fixed query positions
analysis.seed_test: one-sided exact sign test of positive paired seed differences; ties nonpositive
analysis.seed_test_null: Conditional on frozen bank,P(shared-flat>0)<=0.5; initialization replicates assumed independent
analysis.other_contrasts: descriptive, including reset and empirical controls; no additional significance tests
analysis.unsupported_proper_scores: No overall numeric mean; conditional supported mean labeled
analysis.source_preservation_gate_scope: Declared identifiable continuation query points; all-action errors remain descriptive
analysis.empirical_match_rule: Best of four prespecified empirical OOD macro planned-denominator accuracies >= mean shared OOD macro across five seeds minus 0.01; descriptive, no selected-winner test
analysis.query_support_and_preservation_scope: All declared continuation queries; self-contact diagnostic separate
analysis.in_family_reference_nonregression_scope: shared vs flat in-family continuation accuracy, each seed
analysis.in_family_role_pair_scope: Only two_contacts query role-pair records; conjunction across both reversed views

decision_order: STOP on incomplete run or unequal completed exposure
REJECT_CURRENT_CONFIGURATION on candidate identifiable-query competence/support/preservation failure; no automatic cause diagnosis or retuning
REJECT_SUPERIORITY_SIMPLIFY if strongest prespecified empirical OOD macro planned-query accuracy >= candidate mean minus 0.01
KEEP_BOUNDED_ADVANTAGE only if competence, mean gain >=0.05, all five seed differences positive and one-sided sign p<=0.05; independent G1 still not admitted
Otherwise REJECT material architectural advantage at this fixed budget

execution.deterministic_control_reuse: Fit once and collect separately under each of five seed labels; identical checkpoints and repeated deterministic data are not five independent empirical replicates. All repeated execution costs retained.

cost_scope: Exact parameter and realized-exposure match if all 128 updates complete; actual CPU/wall/path work/RSS reported, not matched-consumed-compute superiority.
